findings.text: In Mar 8:33 setting the mind on the things of God is denied of Peter: the act is stated as not done, and the mind is set elsewhere.

parts.grounds: you are not setting your mind on the things of God

findings.text: In Mar 8:33 what the mind is set on is one of two opposites: the things of God or the things of man.
In Mar 8:33 the set of mind is a refusal of the things of God in favour of the things of man, as the verse states it.

parts.grounds: you are not setting your mind

findings.text: In Mar 8:33 the set of mind is named in a rebuke: Jesus turns, sees the disciples, and rebukes Peter, so the correction is spoken in the hearing of the others.

parts.grounds: But turning and seeing his disciples
